concept_options.title: 150 Million Parameters. That's It.
concept_options.visual_approach: 9:16 mute-first kinetic type over dark cyan/amber stills: neural lattice, ranked paper cards, penny+grid, latent spiral, vanishing GPU aisle. Number slams every 2–4s inside the 900x1400 safe zone.
concept_options.target_audience: AI-curious Shorts/Reels/TikTok viewers who know 'parameters' but not ARC-AGI
key_points: BDH-CQ is 150M parameters and #1 on Hugging Face papers/trending (last 30 days).
29.5% pass@2 on public ARC-AGI-1 at $0.0007/task — a new cost–accuracy point.
It reasons in latent space instead of dumping a chain of thought.
concept_options.core_message: The hottest paper of the last 30 days is a tiny model that out-efficient'd the giants.
concept_options.tone: Urgent, dry, slightly smug — tech-bro interrupt without the hype adjectives
concept_options.why_this_works: Frame 1 is a pattern interrupt. The Hub last-30-days skill supplies a live rank, not a guessed topic. Two sourced numbers carry the middle. The latent-vs-CoT line is the only mechanism beat.

concept_options.title: Reasoning Without a Diary
concept_options.hook: This model never writes a chain of thought.
concept_options.visual_approach: 16:9 diagram-led: CoT token stream on the left dying out, latent workspace iterating on the right.
key_points: CoT couples reasoning to serial narration and token cost.
BDH-CQ binds demonstrations into recurrent memory, then iterates in H_r.
ARC-AGI is used as a controlled, verifiable testbed.
concept_options.core_message: You can reason without narrating every step.
concept_options.why_this_works: Attacks the biggest misconception. Wrong container for 'viral right now'.

concept_options.title: What the Hub Is Starring vs What It Is Reading
concept_options.hook: 13,878 likes on a 27B. The #1 paper has 150 million weights.
key_points: Popularity and research heat diverged this month.
concept_options.core_message: The Hub has two leaderboards. Only one is a new reasoning regime.
concept_options.why_this_works: True, but it makes Qwen the co-star. Viral A-story should be the paper.
